title: Standard individual subscription prices
subtitle: One representative paid monthly consumer plan per company, from official pricing pages

rows.quote: The Pro plan is available for $20 per month (US), with pricing in your local currency where supported.
Price: $20/month (billed monthly). API usage is separate and billed independently.
Google AI Pro (5 TB) $19.99/mo. Gemini app access is included with usage limits.
SuperGrok $30/month. Higher rate limits and access to frontier models.
Verified students can get Mistral Pro for $5.99 / month (normally $14.99).

takeaway: Standard individual paid plans range from $14.99 a month at Mistral AI to $30.00 at xAI.
assumptions: One standard paid individual plan per company, using US monthly list price before tax. Annual discounts are excluded.
Features, usage allowances and included storage differ substantially, so price alone is not a value comparison.
API usage is separate. Cohere has no comparable consumer subscription in this table.
